scenarios.name: Distinct event IDs
scenarios.expected_behavior: Duplicate physical events count once per event ID; separate event IDs remain separate uses.

scenarios.name: Denominator-only rows
scenarios.expected_behavior: Unrelated event types contribute conversations and users even with zero feature use.

scenarios.name: Shared conversation agents
scenarios.expected_behavior: Overall distinct conversations differ from totals produced by agent grouping; preserve both.

scenarios.name: Selected users
scenarios.expected_behavior: Inline and external-table user filtering select identical covered rows.

scenarios.name: Time selection and bucketing
scenarios.expected_behavior: Lower-bound inclusive, upper-bound exclusive; Honolulu day and Sunday week buckets remain unchanged.

scenarios.name: Attribute filters
scenarios.expected_behavior: Language, usecase, duration and voicemail filters retain their original row selection.

scenarios.name: Source and developer rows
scenarios.expected_behavior: Legacy feature reader accepts source 9 and developer evidence; population eligibility is a separate contract.

scenarios.name: Latest metadata
scenarios.expected_behavior: Latest metadata value wins; metadata attaches by conversation rather than agent.

scenarios.name: Excluded metadata join settings
scenarios.expected_behavior: Default join settings drop missing-exclusion rows; join_use_nulls=1 retains them.

scenarios.name: Multi-day full RPC averages
scenarios.expected_behavior: One agent spans two days; result and response denominators differ.

scenarios.name: Full RPC responses
scenarios.expected_behavior: Seeded real ClickHouse data exercises daily/weekly grouping, selected/external users, team and agent+team, user enrichment, latest metadata, exclusions and invalid requests.

extraction.boundary: Raw event rows before legacy aggregate
extraction.why: Select conversation ID, agent ID, conversation start, event ID and event type without filtering out denominator-only events.
invariants: Aggregation and response conversion stay in the old RPC

preserved_issues.title: Default LEFT JOIN exclusion drops nonmatching rows
preserved_issues.trigger: An eligible conversation has no excluded metadata row and join_use_nulls=0.
preserved_issues.observed: The joined String key defaults to empty string; IS NULL is false, so the row is dropped. The same fixture qualifies with join_use_nulls=1.
preserved_issues.scope: Preexisting metadata exclusion behavior. A correction belongs in shared metadata filter construction with a dedicated before-fix regression case.

preserved_issues.title: Feature eligibility differs from conversation population
preserved_issues.trigger: An event belongs to source 9 or a developer user.
preserved_issues.observed: Legacy feature statistics retain it. Tests pin this behavior to avoid changing scope during extraction.
preserved_issues.scope: Future Assistance Usage API must choose its population contract separately.

risks: Covered reader and full-RPC scenarios pass on real local ClickHouse; no production performance or exhaustive-state proof.
Non-ClickHouse config/auth/user clients remain mocked with explicit protobuf arguments.
Existing SQL snapshots and separate regression suites are replaced by the consolidated real-data suite.

independent_review.verdict: Reader characterization bodies retain their original expectations after moving into the existing suite. Full-RPC seeded cases replace mocked ClickHouse responses. Production extraction remains byte-identical to the prior reviewed refactor.
